entries.body:
CURRENT [S1.1, S3.1, S7.1] Format: JSON text (json.dumps) object; key "records" = list of {id(int),title,owner,project,amount(str as given)} ascending id; no records -> empty list. Plus "exported_by" per S2.4.
HISTORY [S1.1] Was CSV (csv.writer, header id,title,owner,amount), replaced by S3.1.
CURRENT [S1.2, S4.2] Scope: role admin exports any project; others only records with project in user projects OR owner==user['name'] (others silently omitted).
HISTORY [S1.2] Previously project membership only.
CURRENT [S1.3, S5.1] Status: only active; archived also included only if params include_archived is True AND role admin (other roles never archived).
HISTORY [S1.3] Previously include_archived honoured for any role.
CURRENT [S1.4, S3.2] Date filter: params since YYYY-MM-DD -> only records whose date >= since; date = 'updated' if present else 'created'.
HISTORY [S1.4] Previously used 'created' only.
CURRENT [S1.5] Titles stripped of leading/trailing whitespace.
HISTORY [S1.6] Decision record: date filter introduced for monthly reconciliation runs.
API: export_records(records,user,params)->str; don't mutate input; ignore unknown params; records fields id,title,owner,project,status,amount(str kept),confidential,created,region,[updated].
CURRENT [S5.2] role viewer: no error; exports only records with owner==user['name'] in any project; all other rules apply.
HISTORY [S2.1] Viewer used to raise PermissionError; replaced by S5.2.
CURRENT [S2.2, S4.1] confidential True never exported, except role admin AND params purpose in ('audit','legal'); other rules still apply.
HISTORY [S2.2] Previously audit only.
CURRENT [S2.3, S5.3] params max_records int>=1: only first N (ascending id) after all other rules; N above 25 treated as 25.
CURRENT [S2.4] Obligation: if format changes from CSV, every export in new format includes top-level "exported_by"=user['name'].
CURRENT [S2.5, S4.1] Active (legal purpose allowed): every export includes top-level confidential_count = number of confidential records exported. Obligation: if confidential records ever exported for purpose other than audit, export includes top-level "confidential_count".
HISTORY [S2.6, S6.1] Region 'eu' restriction (needed 'eu' in user regions) withdrawn by S6.1; all regions exported under ordinary rules.
CURRENT [S2.4, S7.2] exported_by=user name in every JSON export EXCEPT role admin, whose exports omit it.
HISTORY [S2.4] Previously exported_by in every export including admin.
HISTORY [S3.3] Note: web UI shows owner display names; exports keep stored owner value.
HISTORY [S4.3] Decision record: move to JSON made for new reporting API.
HISTORY [S6.2] Note: web UI shows 50 records/page; exports unchanged.
HISTORY [S7.3] Decision record: residency restriction lifted after regional data agreement signed.
All 7 stages implemented; ready for final.
